source.name: HC Lada official site, club partners page ('Партнеры и спонсоры ХК «Лада» 2026/2027')
source.note: Translation: 'Title sponsor' — the label under the LADA logo (linking to lada.ru) in the club's 2026/2027 partners section. The LADA wordmark is printed on both shoulder yokes of the home jersey, and on the front of the home helmet: visible in the club's own match-gallery photos (e.g. Lada–Dinamo Minsk, 14.09.2026) and the KHL press-service 2026/27 kit render (sports.ru, 13.09.2026).

source.name: HC Lada official site, club partners page ('Партнеры и спонсоры ХК «Лада» 2026/2027')
source.note: Translation: 'Founder of HC Lada' — the label under the Samara Oblast logo (linking to samregion.ru) in the club's 2026/2027 partners section. The 'САМАРСКАЯ ОБЛАСТЬ' wordmark with the regional coat of arms runs across the front hem of the home jersey: visible in the club's match-gallery photos (e.g. Lada–Dinamo Minsk, 14.09.2026) and the KHL press-service 2026/27 kit render (sports.ru, 13.09.2026).

source.name: HC Lada official site, club partners page ('Партнеры и спонсоры ХК «Лада» 2026/2027')
source.note: Translation: 'Founder of HC Lada' — the label under the Polyplast logo (linking to polyplast-un.ru) in the club's 2026/2027 partners section. The Polyplast logo glyph appears on both legs of the home shorts: visible in the club's match-gallery photos (e.g. Lada–Dinamo Minsk, 14.09.2026) and the KHL press-service 2026/27 kit render (sports.ru, 13.09.2026).

source.name: HC Lada official site, club partners page ('Партнеры и спонсоры ХК «Лада» 2026/2027')
source.note: Translation: 'Founder of HC Lada' — Polyplast's position on the club's partners page. The full 'ПОЛИПЛАСТ' wordmark runs across the lower back of the home jersey (below the player number): visible in the club's own locker-room photo, Lada–CSKA gallery, 25.09.2026 (hclada.ru/media/photo/lada_tsska_moskva_05/).

summary: 2026-27 home kit, checked on the club's own match-gallery photos (Lada–Dinamo Minsk 14.09.2026, Lada–CSKA 25.09.2026) and the KHL press-service kit render (sports.ru, 13.09.2026): club crest front centre; LADA (AvtoVAZ, title sponsor and club namesake) wordmark on both shoulders and on the helmet; 'САМАРСКАЯ ОБЛАСТЬ' with the regional coat of arms across the front hem; Polyplast logo on both shorts legs and full wordmark across the lower back; league-mandated KHL partner patches — MIR above the crest (khl-mir-nspk deal) and T-Bank below the back collar (khl-t-bank deal); FONBET KHL 80 shield on the collar. No sleeve or sock ads.
